messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [valid 2025-08-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-27]
- As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with Team Dune, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-07-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-04-webhooks-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with the Ember team, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-06-20 to 2025-07-04; recorded by handover/2025-06-20-webhooks]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-28, the webhooks service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-03-28 to 2025-06-20; recorded by handover/2025-03-28-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhooks service lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-28; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The webhooks service only ships on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-17]
- As of 2026-03-04, the webhooks service remains a Team Dune service. [valid 2026-03-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-04]
- As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-28-webhooks]
- As of January 2025, the Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus. [valid 2025-01-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-07]
- The Ember team never owned the webhooks service. [valid 2025-07-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-04-webhooks-correction]
- As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-15; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Cinder, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-09-05; recorded by handover/2025-08-29-scheduler]
    earlier: The scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-12-08, the indexer is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-08; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- As of 2025-11-13, the ledger is owned by the Ember team, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service belongs to the Ember team, which took it over from Team Dune. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service belongs to Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Dune. [valid 2025-11-07 to 2025-11-17; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-11-07; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2025-12-01, the resizer is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-01-image-resizer]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-29, the resizer is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-04-29 to 2025-12-01; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
    earlier: The resizer lives with Team Dune. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-04-29; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- As of 2026-04-16, the ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC; the old Wednesday 09:00-11:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-16]
    earlier: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to 2026-04-16; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-18]
